profile.headline: Specialist Software Engineer at L3Harris Technologies
profile.summary: A Computer Engineering graduate with a passion for music, eager to learn more about IoT technology and embedded systems. Always ready and willing to diversify my portfolio and skills to better the world around us. Let's explore and connect!

positions.title: Specialist Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: LaTeX · C++ · Bluetooth Low Energy · Embedded Software · Git · Embedded C · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Embedded Systems

positions.title: EE Software Systems Engineer
positions.description:
• Serves as system engineer for the thermal architecture across all platforms, managing requirement
changes, interface changes to the network, thermal system DFMEA, and specification review
• Analyzes logs to root cause fleet problems and document the best course of corrective action
• Implements network interface changes utilizing git 
• Maintains the diagnostic files for UDS routines
• Develops and maintains multiple CAPL scripts and GUIs that are used in End of Line processes, 
diagnostics, and commissioning activities
• Uses Python to develop scripts for automating network changes and development of JSON file 
manipulation
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Git · Embedded Systems · CAPL · UDS · Python (Programming Language) · Vector CANalyzer

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description: An internship that was focused on various aspects of network security. Using AWS and Carnegie Mellon Insider Threat Data, we created a  system that could detect suspicious activity from log files, through machine learning, and ultimately displayed that data through an elasticsearch linked kibana system.

positions.title: Student Support Consultant
positions.description: Assisting students, staff, and alumni with various troubleshooting and account issues, along with helping the Network Operation Center with outage detection.

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description:
The Clemson Career Workshop is a key part of diversifying Clemson university itself, with many students enrolling in the university after the camp experience.
Helped plan, lead, and facilitate the development of rising high school seniors into a week-long diverse college readiness experience.
